options.name: cap_alert_thresholds
options.description: Set the threshold for triggering capacity usage alerts. Alerts thresholds are calculated from each Storage Pool capacity after deducting the defined amount of spare capacity.

options.name: enable_fragmentation
options.description: Enable/Disable fragmentation of a specific storage pool.

options.name: enable_rebalance
options.description: Enable/Disable rebalance on a specific storage pool.

options.name: enable_rebuild
options.description: Enable/Disable rebuild of a specific storage pool.

options.name: enable_zero_padding
options.description: Enable/Disable zero padding on a specific storage pool.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: media_type
options.description: Type of devices in the storage pool.

options.name: parallel_rebuild_rebalance_limit
options.description: Set rebuild/rebalance parallelism limit of a storage pool.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: persistent_checksum
options.description: Enable/Disable persistent checksum of a specific storage pool.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protected_maintenance_mode_io_priority_policy
options.displayName: Protected Maintenance Mode Io Priority Policy
options.description: Set protected maintenance mode I/O priority policy of a storage pool.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: The id of the protection domain. During creation of a pool, either protection domain name or id must be mentioned. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: The name of the protection domain. During creation of a pool, either protection domain name or id must be mentioned. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: rebalance_io_priority_policy
options.description: Set the rebalance I/O priority policy for a Storage Pool.

options.name: rep_cap_max_ratio
options.description: Set replication journal capacity of a storage pool.

options.name: rmcache_write_handling_mode
options.description: Set RM cache write handling mode of a storage pool. I(Passthrough) Writes skip the cache and are stored in storage only. I(Cached) Writes are stored in both cache and storage (the default). Caching is only performed for IOs whose size is a multiple of 4k bytes.

options.name: spare_percentage
options.description: Set the spare percentage of a specific storage pool.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the storage pool.

options.name: storage_pool_id
options.description: The id of the storage pool. It is auto generated, hence should not be provided during creation of a storage pool. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_name).

options.name: storage_pool_name
options.description: The name of the storage pool. If more than one storage pool is found with the same name then protection domain id/name is required to perform the task. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_id).

options.name: storage_pool_new_name
options.description: New name for the storage pool can be provided. This parameter is used for renaming the storage pool.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: use_rfcache
options.description: Enable/Disable RFcache on a specific storage pool.

options.name: use_rmcache
options.description: Enable/Disable RMcache on a specific storage pool.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vtree_migration_io_priority_policy
options.description: Set the I/O priority policy for V-Tree migration for a specific Storage Pool.
